tools.name: post_api_geo_get_location_details_by_ip
tools.description: Retrieve detailed geolocation information for an IPv4 or IPv6 address, including country, city, state, latitude, longitude, timezone, ASN, ISP/organization, and metadata. Billing per call: 1 Credits.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "spvn-tech-ip-geolocation-and-asn-lookup-api" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: post_api_geo_get_location_details_by_ip · Public sink: post_api_geo_get_location_details_by_ip.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: post_api_geo_get_location_details_by_ip · Public sink: post_api_geo_get_location_details_by_ip

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
